name: Gasthof Schönau
beschreibung: The Gasthof Schönau is located in the municipality of Erl in the Austrian federal state of Tirol. The accommodation is a traditional inn with regional cuisine. The rooms are functionally furnished and clean. The house has a garden restaurant and parking spaces. The surroundings are characterized by the Alpine landscape. Hiking trails and the Festspielhaus are nearby. The atmosphere is down-to-earth and quiet.
